query:
SELECT lower(r.batch_id) AS "key!", x.status AS "status!",
                                  count(*) AS "count!"
                           FROM svs.runs r
                           JOIN svs.run_results x ON x.run_id = r.id
                           WHERE lower(r.batch_id) = ANY ($1) AND x.status IS NOT NULL
                             AND svs.run_matches(r, $2)
                           GROUP BY 1, 2
